input.body:
Address: Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 1ZZ

Hi,

The tenant of this property has reported the following. Can you please advise if you wish for me to instruct a contractor to attend or if you want to arrange your own contractor?

Request description: "Dish washer repair, the dish washer turns on, fills up and seems to wash but never ever stops it's cycle"

The tenant says the problem started recently. We have classed this as a routine repair. No photos have been provided so far.

If the dishwasher is still under a manufacturer or retailer warranty, please let us know so we can send the repair through the warranty first. Also, if you would like a quote before any work is done, please say so.

Ref: TKT-BE50D5

Dear Tenant,

Thank you for reporting the dishwasher fault at Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk (ref TKT-BE50D5). We have logged it as a routine repair and asked your landlord how they would like to go ahead. We will update you once we hear back.

While you wait, please try these quick checks. They often fix a cycle that won't finish:
1. Turn the dishwasher off at the wall or isolator switch for 5 to 10 minutes, then turn it back on and run a short programme. This resets the controls.
2. Make sure the door is fully shut and latched, and that no dishes or utensils are stopping it from closing.
3. Take out and clean the filter at the bottom of the machine. A blocked filter can stop it draining and finishing the cycle.
4. Check that the drain hose behind or under the machine isn't kinked or squashed, and that the sink waste it connects to isn't blocked.
5. Make sure the tap or valve feeding the machine is fully open.
6. If the display shows an error code or warning light, please send us a photo.

If these checks fix the problem, please let us know and we will close the request. If an engineer comes out and the fault turns out to be one of these checks, the call-out may be chargeable.

If you ever see water leaking, notice a burning smell, or the machine trips the electrics, switch it off at the isolator straight away and contact us immediately.

When an engineer is booked, we will let them know about your two guinea pigs.

Kind regards,
Maintenance Team
